@asahay19: This pull request references [OCPNODE-4494](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/OCPNODE-4494) which is a valid jira issue.

Warning: The referenced jira issue has an invalid target version for the target branch this PR targets: expected the story to target the "5.0.0" version, but no target version was set.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/origin/pull/31266):

>This PR adds an end-to-end test that validates MCO's guard blocking a RHCOS 9→10 OS stream transition when a MachineConfigPool has runc configured as the default container runtime. Also this PR contains runc_upgrade_cases.md file which contains the Test Plan with all the required meta data.
>
>**What the test does**
>- Creates an isolated MachineConfigPool (runc-rhcos10-guard) pinned to spec.osImageStream: rhel-9 and a runc CRI-O drop-in MachineConfig
>- Labels one pure worker into the pool and waits for a healthy baseline rollout
>- Verifies the node is on RHCOS 9 with runc as the default runtime
>- Patches the pool's osImageStream to rhel-10
>- Asserts the guard fires: MCP Degraded=True + RenderDegraded=True with a message referencing runc and rhel-10
>- Confirms the node remains on RHCOS 9 with runc (rollout was blocked)
>- Cleans up: removes node label, waits for pool to drain to zero machines, deletes MC and MCP
>- Skips on: MicroShift, Hypershift
>
>MCO change PR: https://github.com/openshift/machine-config-operator/pull/5891
>
>
>
>

</details>

You can configure this behavior by changing the `reviews.auto_review.auto_pause_after_reviewed_commits` setting. > > Use the following commands to manage reviews: > - `@coderabbitai resume` to resume automatic reviews. > - `@coderabbitai review` to trigger a single review. > > Use the checkboxes below for quick actions: > - [ ] ▶️ Resume reviews > - [ ] 🔍 Trigger review ## Walkthrough Adds a disruptive Ginkgo node e2e that verifies MCO blocks an OSImageStream move rhel-9 → rhel-10 when CRI-O default runtime is runc, with helpers to create/label/update/poll/verify/recover a dedicated MachineConfigPool and ContainerRuntimeConfig plus a companion test plan. ## Changes **runc RHCOS 10 upgrade guard test** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Suite scaffolding and gating**
`test/extended/node/runc_upgrade_cases.go`|Go imports, constants for pool/stream names and degraded-pool messages, BeforeEach environment gating (skip MicroShift/Hypershift/single-replica), and OSImageStream preflight check ensuring `rhel-9` and `rhel-10` availability.| |**Main test orchestration**
`test/extended/node/runc_upgrade_cases.go`|Central Ginkgo It block coordinating: label worker into custom pool, create MCP pinned to rhel-9 + CRC with `default_runtime: runc`, poll baseline rollout on rhel-9 and assert node runtime/version, patch MCP to rhel-10 and assert Degraded/RenderDegraded guard signals, validate CO/CVO upgrade-blocked conditions, verify node stability, revert MCP to rhel-9 and wait for recovery.| |**Setup: MCP, CRC, and node labeling**
`test/extended/node/runc_upgrade_cases.go`|Create pool-specific `MachineConfigPool` pinned to `rhel-9` with node-role selector, create pool-targeted `ContainerRuntimeConfig` with `default_runtime: runc`, and label a randomly chosen pure worker node into the pool.| |**Guard detection and upgrade blocking validation**
`test/extended/node/runc_upgrade_cases.go`|Poll MCP render-degraded with message containing both `runc` and `rhel-10` identifier; verify ClusterOperator machine-config shows `Upgradeable=False` with degraded-pool reason (not `Degraded`), and ClusterVersion remains `Available=True` without `Progressing`/`Degraded`.| |**Node state verification and recovery**
`test/extended/node/runc_upgrade_cases.go`|Verify node `Ready` with matching MCO `currentConfig` and `desiredConfig` annotations; extract and verify runc in CRI-O default runtime drop-in; extract RHEL major version from `/etc/os-release`; poll node MCO rollback until `currentConfig==desiredConfig` and custom pool name is absent; poll MCP recovery clearing `Degraded`/`RenderDegraded`, `Updated=True`, and aligned ready/machine counts.| |**Utility helpers and cleanup**
`test/extended/node/runc_upgrade_cases.go`|Condition status lookup from ClusterOperator/ClusterVersion slices; MCP machine count polling with NotFound tolerance; set MCP `spec.OSImageStream`; remove node label with conflict-retry; delete CRC/MCP treating NotFound as success; AfterEach cleanup sequence: remove label, delete CRC, wait machine count zero, wait node rollback, delete MCP, wait node re-align to worker MCP.| |**Test documentation**
`test/extended/node/runc_upgrade_cases.md`|UC-1 test plan: scope/skip conditions (MicroShift, Hypershift, SNO, missing dual streams, missing pure-worker topology), step-flow diagram (setup → pin rhel-9 + runc → baseline → rhel-10 patch → guard assertion → revert → cleanup), helper function role mapping, detailed pass/fail criteria covering streams, baseline expectations, guard firing, node persistence, CO/CVO states, and cleanup completion; run instructions and CI lane guidance.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TestRunner participant API_Server participant MachineConfigOperator participant Node participant ClusterVersion TestRunner->>API_Server: create MachineConfigPool (rhel-9) & ContainerRuntimeConfig (runc) API_Server->>MachineConfigOperator: notify new MCP/CRC MachineConfigOperator->>Node: render and apply ignition + runc drop-in Node-->>MachineConfigOperator: report currentConfig and OS version (rhel-9) TestRunner->>API_Server: patch MCP.spec.OSImageStream → rhel-10 API_Server->>MachineConfigOperator: new desired OSImageStream (rhel-10) MachineConfigOperator->>MachineConfigOperator: detect runc + rhel-10 → set Degraded & RenderDegraded MachineConfigOperator-->>ClusterVersion: ensure CV remains Available (no Progressing/Degraded) TestRunner->>API_Server: patch MCP.spec.OSImageStream → rhel-9 (recovery) MachineConfigOperator->>Node: reconcile to rhel-9, clear degraded ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes --- > [!CAUTION] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. The runc guard test passed in the 2of2 shard.
https://prow.ci.openshift.org/view/gs/test-platform-results/logs/openshift-origin-31266-nightly-5.0-e2e-aws-disruptive-longrunning-techpreview-2of2/2074543299347091456
The 1of2 failures are imagepolicy MCP timeouts and a missing /etc/node-sizing.env.
None of them look caused by this PR.

A few non-blocking observations:
- Some waitFor* functions take a timeout argument, others don't. It would be nice to be consistent.
- The test finishes in ~10 minutes; some of the 30-minute timeouts could be tightened.
- The various waitFor* helpers all poll nodes/MCPs/COs with similar boilerplate, we could share the fetch logic and just take a check function from callers.

None of these block merge.
